## Question

Does response-independent phylogenetic position (PEV1–PEV3) explain response structure while reproducing the validated Step 19 tree and coordinates?

## Dataset and sample size

The tree and PCoA contain exactly the 526 downstream species; the PEV model uses all 1,604 effects and 42 experiments.

## Exact model specification

The canonical tree is rebuilt with pinned V.PhyloMaker2 scenario 3. The PEV sequence compares climate-only `M0`, additive PEV `M1`, and the anchored PEV-by-climate `M3`.

## Assumptions

Placement decisions and axis signs are response-independent. Shared parent placements retain zero patristic distance.

## Convergence and covariance diagnostics

Tree topology/branch lengths, PCoA eigenstructure, coordinate tolerances, package provenance, model comparisons, and CR1 are shown below.

## Main numerical results

```{r}
validation <- targets::tar_read(phylogeny_reproduction_validation)
eigen <- targets::tar_read(pcoa_eigen_summary)
package <- targets::tar_read(phylogeny_package_source_provenance)
package_gate <- targets::tar_read(phylogeny_package_validation)
artifacts <- targets::tar_read(phylogeny_reference_artifact_validation)
interface <- targets::tar_read(pev_modeling_interface_526)
tables <- targets::tar_read(phylogeny_model_tables_526)
fit_gate <- targets::tar_read(phylogeny_model_fit_equivalence)
comparison_gate <- targets::tar_read(phylogeny_model_comparisons_equivalence)
cr1_gate <- targets::tar_read(phylogeny_model_CR1_equivalence)
knitr::kable(validation)
knitr::kable(eigen[seq_len(min(10, nrow(eigen))), ])
knitr::kable(package)
knitr::kable(package_gate)
knitr::kable(artifacts)
knitr::kable(interface$audit)
knitr::kable(tables$fit_statistics)
knitr::kable(tables$comparisons)
knitr::kable(tables$CR1)
knitr::kable(dplyr::bind_rows(fit_gate, comparison_gate, cr1_gate))
```

## Interpretation boundary

PEV1–PEV3 are selected and oriented without reference to Delta AUC. The
modeling interface first verifies the independently recomputed coordinates,
then uses the byte-preserving validated coordinate values so eigensolver noise
cannot be amplified by the meta-regression optimizer.

## Canonical objects

`resident_phylogeny_rebuild`, `resident_pcoa_candidate`, `pev_modeling_interface_526`, and `phylogeny_model_tables_526`.

## PASS/FAIL

All tree, placement, distance, zero-distance, PEV, eigenstructure, model, CR1, and immutable-hash checks must pass.
